spans.s:
धम a. (मा or मी f.) [धम् ध्माने
अच्] (Usually at the end of a
comp.)
1 Blowing; अग्निंधम,
नाडिंधम.
--2 Melting, fusing.
--मः
1 The
moon.
--2 An epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
--3 Of Yama, the god of death.
--4
Of Brahmā.

धामकः A sort of weight, (माष
q. v.).

धमधमा An onomatopoetic word
expressive of the sound made by
blowing with a bellows or a trumpet.

धमन a.
1 A Blowing.
--2 Cruel.
--नः A kind of reed.

धमनिः, --नी f.
1 A reed, blow-pipe.
--2 A tube or canal of the human
body, tubular vessel, as a vein, a
nerve, &c.
--3 Throat, neck.
--4 A
speech.

धमनिः, --नी f.
1 A reed, blow-pipe.
--2 A tube or canal of the human
body, tubular vessel, as a vein, a
nerve, &c.
--3 Throat, neck.
--4 A
speech.
धमिः f. The act of blowing.

धम्मलः, धम्मिलः, धम्मिल्लः The
braided and ornamented hair
of a woman tied over the head
and intermixed with flowers,
pearls, &c.; आकुलाकुलगलद्धम्मिल्ल˚

धम्मलः, धम्मिलः, धम्मिल्लः The
braided and ornamented hair
of a woman tied over the head
and intermixed with flowers,
pearls, &c.; आकुलाकुलगलद्धम्मिल्ल˚

धम्मलः, धम्मिलः, धम्मिल्लः The
braided and ornamented hair
of a woman tied over the head
and intermixed with flowers,
pearls, &c.; आकुलाकुलगलद्धम्मिल्ल˚

धामन् n. [धा-मनिन्]
1 A
dwelling-place, abode, residence, house;
तुरासाहं पुरोधाय धाम स्वायंभुवं ययुः

.
--2 A place, site, resort; श्रियो
धाम.
--3 The inmates of a house,
members of a family.
--4 A ray of
light; धाम्नातिशाययति धाम सहस्रधाम्नः

.
--8 Birth.
--9 The body.
--10 A troop,
host.
--11 State, condition.
--12 A
class.
--13 Ved. Law, rule.
--14 Ved.
Property, wealth.
--15 A fetter.
--16
Fashion, mode, manner.
--Comp.
--केशिन्, m.
--निधिः the sun.
--छद् m.
Ved. N. of Agni.
